name: aimemory
description: 企业 AI 记忆库：让 agent 跨会话记住部署经验、踩坑记录、项目约定与个人偏好。安装后提供 aimemory skill 与 /aimemory 命令；MCP 服务器按你的客户端标准方式配置（ZCode 由插件注入，Claude Code 见 README 用标准配置）。

description_i18n.en: Enterprise AI memory: agents remember deployment experience, pitfalls, project conventions and personal preferences across sessions. Ships the aimemory skill and /aimemory commands; MCP server is configured per your client's standard way (ZCode injects via plugin, Claude Code uses standard config per README).
